P2: total director + employee remuneration of m x the dividend (m = 2 or 3 reported as negotiating options; Reddit-sourced). null = off. Modelled as: reduced-regime dividends AND liquidation-reserve allocations in a year are capped at that year's payroll / m; amounts above the cap are taxed at the ordinary 30% (dividends) or stay in the free reserve (allocations). The cap applies to every reduced-regime payment from the start year, old reserves included. Payroll = director pay + employee gross wage, same calendar year

P3: reduced dividend regimes (VVPRbis, liquidation reserve) withdrawn for single-director companies working almost exclusively for one client for several years, for NEW amounts from the start year. Modelled as: in a year when the owner's largest-client share was >= threshold in every year of the lookback window (current year included), the post-tax profit of that year goes to the ordinary reserve and cannot be allocated to the liquidation reserve; older amounts keep their regime
